item.title: Tranmere Rovers' Joe Ironside looks ahead to Crawley Town (H)
item.description: Tranmere Rovers’ Joe Ironside talked to the press ahead of our 3pm home kick-off against Crawley Town on Saturday 14th February 2026. Speaking at his pre-match press conference, he said: "I think we moved the ball a lot better (at Gillingham) than in previous games. We didn't take them all, but we created chances. There was a good energy among the team." You can watch his full interview below.

item.title: Tranmere Rovers manager Andy Crosby previews Crawley Town (H)
item.description: Tranmere Rovers manager Andy Crosby spoke to the media ahead of our 3pm home kick-off against Crawley Town on Saturday 14th January 2026. Speaking at his pre-match press conference, he said: "We're going to need everyone to make it a really special Saturday afternoon at Prenton Park. I want the players to reward the supporters, playing the game how we want going forward." You can watch his interview below.

item.title: Africa Oye sponsor Zech Obiero for the rest of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are pleased to announce Africa Oyé as the business sponsor of Zech Obiero for the rest of the 2025/26 season. Africa Oyé, the UK’s largest celebration of African music and culture, takes place annually in Liverpool. Beginning in 1992 as a series of small gigs in the city centre, the event has gone from strength to strength, moving to its present Sefton Park home in 2002 to cope with demand. item.title: Tranmere Rovers 2-0 Crawley Town: Match Report
item.description: Tranmere Rovers won 2-0 at home to Crawley Town thanks to home debutant Zech Obiero’s first goal for the Club and striker Joe Ironside’s penalty. In the sixth minute, Obiero’s effort was saved, and Sam Finley scored the rebound; the goal was disallowed for offside, but it wasn’t a momentum-killer. Six minutes later, however, Obiero broke into the box and fired into the roof of the net, giving Rovers the lead with his first goal.
